w:r.w:t: # Royal Color Analysis & Styling — Website Personalization Questionnaire
Welcome! This questionnaire will help me customize your
website

so it truly feels like *you*. There are no wrong answers — just write naturally, and don't worry about grammar or polish. I'll handle the wordsmithing. If you're unsure about something, just say so and we'll figure it out together.
Take your time. You don't have to answer everything in one sitting.
## PART 1: YOUR STORY
These questions help me write your About page and homepage in a way that connects with potential clients. People book people, not services — so your story matters!
**1.1 What's your full name, and how do you want clients to address
you?*
Daphna Weiner address me as Daphna
**1.2 How did you first discover color analysis?
When I was a teenager and my mom had a book about it What drew you to it? I love color and thought it was fascinating that it can impact us as individuals
> Think about that "aha" moment. Was it something someone did for you? A class you took? A YouTube video that changed how you saw yourself? Tell the story.
I knew I wanted to do something in the fashion/beauty space.
after
researching color analysis for a few
years
I
decide
I wanted to learn about it.
so
I took a class on color theory and color analysis and fell in love. I realized how much wearing our colors impacts our life and how we feel about ourselves.
**1.3 Was there a specific moment when you decided to turn this into a business?
After I took the
class
I knew this is something I wanted to peruse
> What pushed you from "this is interesting" to "I want to do this for other people"?
after
having my own color analysis done, I realized I’m a lot more confident in my outfits. Shopping has become more intentional. I wanted
other
woman to feel the same.
**1.4 What did you do before this? (It's okay if this is your first business
I
was a realtor for over 20 years!
> Your previous experience — even if it seems unrelated — often shapes how you work with
clients. A teacher brings patience. A nurse brings care. A retail manager brings an eye for style. What's your background
? I was a realtor for 20 years. I had a
2 year

stint in which I worked as a fashion consultant and loved it. I love helping other people and am very intuitive. I have a great eye for design and style. The two combined I feel like is the perfect match to be a color analyst and stylist.
**1.5 Have you completed any training or certifications in color analysis, styling, or image consulting
Yes
I was trained by the color analysis queen herself. I am trained in the
16 palette
method which after research decided is the best and most accurate.

> List anything you've done — online courses, in-person training, certifications, mentorships. If you're currently studying, that counts too! If you haven't done formal training yet, just say so — we can word things carefully.
I am a certified color analyst with years of styling experience.
**1.6 What color analysis system do you use (or plan to use)?**
the 16 palette system taught by the international image institute
> If you're not sure what this means, here are the common ones:
> - **4-Season** (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter)
> - **12-Season** (breaks each season into 3 sub-types)
> - **16-Season** (even more specific)
> - **Sci/ART** (science-based approach)
> - **Custom / blend** (your own approach)
> - **Not sure yet** — that's fine!
**1.7 In 2-3 sentences, how would you describe what you do to a stranger at a party?**
I make them feel comfortable and heard. I connect.
> Don't overthink this — just write how you'd actually say it out loud.
**1.8 What makes you different from other color analysts or stylists?**
I feel like I have a great eye for fashion and styling and also am intuitive to a person’s individual style.
> Think about: your personality, your approach, your background, who you work with, how you make people feel. Even if you're new, you bring something unique. What is it?
I bring a whole approach to fashion and beauty. It is something I am passionate about and love.

Understanding who you want to attract helps me write copy that speaks directly to them. The more specific you are, the better the website will connect.

they?*
anyone that would like to feel better about how they look and dress. I would prefer you
be
over the age of 13

anyone

you?*

attract?*
